text:
Riley (support): FYI we've got a customer report: a large account says objects with custom TTLs didn't vanish after scheduled deletion window. They see a delayed batch delete for ~12k keys.
Ava Nguyen: @Riley can you paste the customer org and sample object IDs?
Riley (support): org: corp-x-345, sample ids: obj_8a3f, obj_98b2, obj_ef12. They said the delete API returned 202 but objects remained searchable for ~6 hours. :thinking_face:
Chris Patel: Do we have any recent keystore maintenance or HSM key rollover that could block deletion?
eng-ops-bot: Note: scheduled keystore rotation completed 2024-05-20T02:00Z. No HSM rekey in last 72h.
Riley (support): Customer timeline: deletion requested 2024-05-20T04:12Z, API returned 202 at 04:12:03, audit log entry missing for that request between 04:10-04:20Z. They opened a legal hold 05/19 but only for a subset of buckets.
Ava Nguyen: Missing audit logs is worrying. @LegalOps Bot can you confirm whether the preserve flag was applied at account level?
LegalOps Bot: corp-x-345 preserve_mode: false; litigation_hold: true for bucket finance-logs (only). No org-wide preserve.
Chris Patel: Ok so preserve isn't blocking. Could be a backlog in deletion worker queue or a KV-lock during keystore rotation. Riley, can you get us the customer's request id and the response headers?
Riley (support): Request ID: req_20240520_4a7e. Response headers: 
```
HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
x-request-id: req_20240520_4a7e
x-delete-queue-offset: 147893
```
They also shared a small repro: run delete for a list of ids and query search immediately after.
Chris Patel: Repro steps for staging I'll try: 
1) create 5 test objects with custom ttl=10s
2) call DELETE batch API /v1/objects/batch-delete
3) poll search endpoint every 15s for 5 minutes
Command: 
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/objects/batch-delete \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"ids":["obj_a","obj_b","obj_c"]}'
```
I'll attach logs.
eng-ops-bot: Observed transient spike in deletion-processor lag 2024-05-20T03:50-05:20Z due to GC pause on node gpu-batch-12. Backpressure caused queue offsets to grow.
Ava Nguyen: That lines up — if deletion-processor ack lags, search index may still surface soft-delete markers until worker confirms tombstone. Need to confirm whether tombstones are created immediately or upon background worker commit.
Riley (support): Customer also reported a 500 on /v1/audit/export when they tried to pull logs for 04:12Z. Error: {"error":"internal_server_error","code":500}. They raised support ticket 78923.
Chris Patel: 500 on audit export could be related — if audit pipeline was overloaded, entries might not have been recorded. I'll check the audit pipeline metrics and KMS access logs. Can someone fetch KMS call logs around 03:45-05:00Z?
eng-ops-bot: KMS logs: observed increased latency contacting HSM gateway 03:48-04:10Z (p95 ~ 2.3s, baseline 0.12s). Several retries from storage-writer service.
Ava Nguyen: Increased KMS latency + deletion processor GC pause = good candidate for root cause. Short-term mitigation: recommend customer to run a confirm-delete endpoint that forces tombstone and returns when index updated, and we can re-run audit export. Also propose to backfill audit events for their time window.
Riley (support): Customer wants timeline for when objects will be fully purged and whether any data was exposed in search results during delay.
Chris Patel: For timeline: once deletion-processor recovers, backlog will drain at ~8k/s, so 12k keys ~1.5s once it catches up, but index propagation could add minutes. For exposure: search shows soft-deleted objects (not accessible via object-get) — need to correlate logs to prove no plaintext leak.
Ava Nguyen: Action items: 
- @Chris check audit pipeline and KMS call trace and create incident if HSM gateway errors persist (INC-xxxxx)
- @eng-ops-bot collect deletion-processor GC traces + node heap dumps from gpu-batch-12
- @Riley coordinate with customer: provide repro steps, request list of visible object search hits and timestamps, and offer a backfill export of audit logs
- LegalOps to approve backfill export if permitted
LegalOps Bot: Backfill export for corp-x-345 cleared on principle; please route export through compliance-approved channel.
Riley (support): I'll send the customer a concise update: we believe transient KMS/HSM latency + deletion-processor backlog caused a delayed tombstone commit. Repro steps attached, escalation to eng on it. :thumbsup:
Chris Patel: I'll post updates in #incidents if I open an infra incident. Thanks everyone. :eyes:
